product.ingredients_text: Protein Blend (Calcium Caseinate (Milk), Whey NUTRIT Protein Isolate (Milk)), Milk Chocolate with Sweetener (20%) INFORM (Sweetener: Maltitol: Cocoa Butter, Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Mass, Emulsifier: Soy Lecithin; Natural Flavouring), Bovine Collagen Energy (kJ Hydrolysate, Humectant: Glycerol; Sweeteners: Maltitol, Sucralose; Energy (ko Palm Oil, Water, Fat - reduced Cocoa Powder (3%), Wheat Flour, Wheat Starch, Rapeseed Oil, Bulking Agent: Polydextrose; Sea Salt, Emulsifier: Soy Lecithin; Raising Agents: Ammonium Carbonates, Sodium Carbonates; Acidity Regulator: Sodium Hydroxide; Flavouring. ALLERGY ADVICE: For allergens including cereals containing gluten, see ingredients in bold. May also contain Nuts.
